Life & Character

You must know how to spot bad energy around your life. You can't just keep allowing negativity all in the name of friendship or tolerance.

August 12 2 min read Latunde Akin

You must know how to spot bad energy around your life. You can't just keep allowing negativity all in the name of friendship or tolerance.
Did you know even you yourself can be a source of bad energy against yourself?
You will notice this when you relate with people and you don't care about leaving them better than you met them.
You will notice this when your anger level is becoming abnormal. You get angry easily over little things.
You will notice this when you always feel bad about others progress.
You will notice bad energy in your life when there are certain sins you commit consistently.
Even in your dream life,you will notice its always nightmares or bad dreams. Presence of negative energies.
You entertain dirty rooms, dirty kitchen, dirty food stores etc. Those dirtiness attracts negative energies you know?
You have people close you as friends or family, but they never make you feel good. Instead it's betrayals upon betrayals. No ounce of loyalty exists among those you call close associates. It's either you're the problem or they are the bad energies positioned to hinder you.
You showed yourself friendly but you get betrayed in return.
For every negative energy you allowed, simply understand that that is what demons feed upon. They need those negative energies to survive, so they are always attracted to it. They are always around every negative energies.
Reason you must learn how to neutralise every negative energy around you with either your good attitude (fruits of the Spirit) or total separation from such carriers of negative energies.
IDo you know there are people you will even help or give something to and their hidden negative energies will affect you? Not because they don't need your help, yes they need it but what's is in their lives is all negatively conditioned. Likewise there are people that will also help you with a negative energy.
The beauty of life is just to understand how to be positive always in every situation. How to use distance against negative person. And how to know the best way to neutralise negative energies.
A man who is not genuinely regenerated in Christ will be missing on this. There are many people who are just religious but lack power to behave well. Such can't know how to really fight in a spiritual warfare except making mouth. Because in a spiritual warfare, we must understand that fruit of the Spirit are the real weapons of warfare and not any gift or skills.
Learn.
Your brother
Latunde Akin
